value.reply: Here's what I found near Springfield for Mia and Leo. Swim lessons for Mia, storytime and a drop-in playgroup that fit both of them.
groupLeads: Swim lessons at the community pool for ages 3 to 5, Saturdays at 10:00. That's the one that suits Mia.
Library storytime for all ages on Tuesdays at 10:30, free. And a drop-in playgroup for ages 0 to 6 on weekday mornings, also free. Both fit Leo and Mia.
